ideas.pitch: A real-time analytics dashboard designed for ICPC-style mock contests to track problem-solving velocity, code submission patterns, and team bottlenecks.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0 is an ICPC-style algorithmic contest where teams need deep performance tracking and strategy optimization during high-pressure sessions.
ideas.title: ICPC Performance Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a direct pain point for competitive programmers and contest organizers by streamlining post-contest analysis and team strategy.

ideas.pitch: A synchronized collaborative coding workspace built specifically for multi-person teams participating in online coding challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0 requires teams of 2-3 members to coordinate effectively during a 4-hour high-stakes online programming challenge.
ideas.title: AlgoStreak Collaborative Notebook
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on remote team collaboration dynamics which are crucial during online contests with strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted code snippet analyzer that helps practice platforms detect anomaly patterns and logic duplication in competitive programming.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0 enforces strict proctoring and monitoring measures to ensure a fair and transparent contest environment.
ideas.title: ContestGuardian Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the organizer's emphasis on maintaining fairness, integrity, and minimizing plagiarism risks during online execution.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first snippet manager and algorithm template repository optimized for competitive programmers during timed contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0 is a fast-paced 4-hour contest featuring 12-14 complex algorithmic problems where quick reference is key.
ideas.title: CP-Notes QuickReference
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a time-management hurdle faced by every participant trying to recall or look up standard graph and DP templates under pressure.

ideas.pitch: A synchronized multi-screen countdown and task assignment widget built for teams sharing problems during online coding marathons.
ideas.problem_statement: Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0 involves multiple members collaborating remotely during a short 4-hour window.
ideas.title: TeamSync ICPC Timer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate utility for teams looking to optimize task division and problem allocation without wasting precious seconds.
